data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Resumption must always be refused when the run used non-deterministic external components (tool calls, API queries, random sampling with real-world entropy) whose side effects cannot be reconstructed from the event log alone, even if the halt was perfectly clean and the log chain is intact. In these cases, the committed events record that an action was taken, but the external world state it produced cannot be recovered by replay, so resuming from the log would either repeat the action (double-execution) or assume state that no longer holds.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If all external side effects are idempotent (e.g., a read-only API call, or a write with a deterministic key that overwrites rather than appends), then re-execution is safe and resumption may proceed.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the event log records not just the action but the full external response (input and output of every tool call), then the system can replay using recorded responses without re-invoking external services, making resumption safe even for non-idempotent actions.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the system checkpoints external world state alongside event commits (e.g., snapshots of all external service states), then reconstruction is possible\u2014but this is typically infeasible.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the reasoning system is purely internal (no external calls, deterministic generation), this objection vanishes entirely and resumption depends only on log integrity.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Consider a run that called an external API to send an email at event E_5, then halted at E_8 due to budget exhaustion. The log faithfully records E_1..E_8 with intact identity. On resumption, the system replays E_1..E_8 to reconstruct state. But the email was already sent\u2014the external world has moved on. If resumption tries to re-execute E_5, it sends a duplicate. If it skips E_5, it assumes the email's effect on the reasoning state without verifying the external world. Either way, the resumed run's behavior diverges from what a uninterrupted run would have produced. The event log preserves identity but not external-world causality.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
